messages:
julia_support: Heads-up — NimbleHealth procurement replied. They say they will not accept an invoice without an official PO number and a purchase order PDF on file. They pasted the procurement email below. cc @mike_sales

nimble_finops: Hi Redwood team — procurement policy requires a PO for any vendor invoice. They can provide PO only after our internal legal review completes; estimated 3–5 business days. They can send the PO PDF and the reference number once available.

mike_sales: Thanks. Do we have any prior agreement that allows invoicing without PO? I can't find an executed SOW that mentions exceptions.

ash_billing: No SOW exception on file. Our billing system (Stripe/Aria connector) needs either a customer PO number on the invoice or an approved internal exemption. Until then we can't finalize invoice generation. We can issue a PROFORMA if they need a document for internal approvals.

julia_support: They asked if we can "hold invoice until PO" or alternatively send a proforma to start the approval pipeline. They also want the invoice to include the exact bill-to entity name and VAT number.

ash_billing: Actionable steps from finance side: 1) We can generate a proforma invoice immediately with placeholder invoice number. 2) Once we receive the signed PO PDF and PO number (e.g., `PO-54872-NH`), billing will attach it to the invoice record and issue the official invoice. 3) If they need the VAT field filled, they must send legal entity and VAT number in the PO header.

mike_sales: I'll ping the customer procurement contact directly and request the PDF + VAT details. Suggest copying the exact wording they need on the PO to avoid rework. Also looping in @ash_billing to confirm the proforma format.

procurement-bot: Reminder: create ticket FIN-6321 to track PO attachment and proforma issuance. Assigned to ash_billing.

ash_billing: Created FIN-6321. I'll attach the proforma and flag for rapid update once PO arrives. I also need billing contact email from NimbleHealth to send the proforma PDF.

julia_support: Customer replied with contact: finance-ops@nimblehealth.com. They said the procurement office is fine with a proforma to start approvals but will not sign it — they need a separate PO doc from their procurement tool.

mike_sales: Copying template suggestion to speed things up: "Please include: Full legal name, Billing address, VAT/Tax ID, PO number, Contact email for invoice receipt." I'll send that wording.

ash_billing: One small wrinkle: if the PO is created with a different legal name than the account in our system, the invoice process requires a manual override and tax-team review (could add 24–48h). Let me know if procurement will use alternate legal entity.

julia_support: They confirmed same legal name. So override not needed.

mike_sales: Update to NimbleHealth: we'll send proforma now to finance-ops@nimblehealth.com and follow up for the PO PDF. Expect official invoice issuance after PO is attached.

nimble_finops: Received proforma, thanks. Will circulate internally and aim to return PO PDF by end of week.

ash_billing: Great — I'll mark FIN-6321 with status "proforma sent" and wait for PO PDF. If PO arrives with PO number `PO-54872-NH`, billing will finalize invoice and email it to finance-ops@nimblehealth.com.

julia_support: Closing loop here. Please escalate if PO timeline slips past EOW. :thumbsup:
